user.title: HAPatchY
user.description: Manage exact single-file patches within the Home Assistant configuration.

user.title: Configure patch
user.description: Choose one file and a UTF-8 unified diff. HA and HAPatchY internal files are protected.

data.name: Name
data.source: Local path or direct HTTPS URL

options.title: Behavior and verification
options.description: Disabling backups removes the recovery copy for apply operations. Revert always creates a backup.

confirm_backup_disabled.title: Confirm configuration
confirm_backup_disabled.description: Backup before apply is disabled. You may be unable to recover the original bytes. Revert always creates a backup. No file has been changed.

confirm_conflict.title: Confirm configuration
confirm_conflict.description: The patch does not uniquely match the current file. Nothing will be changed until the conflict is resolved. If you disabled backups, future apply operations will not create recovery copies.

confirm_missing_target.title: Confirm configuration
confirm_missing_target.description: The target file is missing. The patch will wait for it to appear. If you disabled backups, future apply operations will not create recovery copies.
